purpose: Define governance rules and promotion criteria for projectional equivalence proofs.

promotion_rules.C1: Claim is syntactically valid and invariant-indexed.
promotion_rules.C4: Simulation or worked examples support preservation.
promotion_rules.C5: Counterexamples have been tested or bounded.
promotion_rules.C6: Formal derivation from the axiomatic floor is complete.

hard_blocks.effect: Automatic rejection of claim status elevation above C0.
hard_blocks.reason: Projectional equivalence is undefined without a specific invariant index.

hard_blocks.effect: Automatic rejection of claim status elevation above C0.
hard_blocks.reason: The indexed invariant must exist in the Invariant Registry.
Falsifiability is required for structural and supported claims (C3+).
Operational justification of preservation is required for structural and supported claims (C3+).
Level C6 requires formal closure rooted in the axiomatic floor.
